description.value: A 94-site private campground in Squamish sitting along the Sea to Sky corridor, offering a functional base for cyclists between Vancouver and Whistler with easy highway access and device charging on-site. No standout natural feature at the campground itself, but world-class climbing, mountain biking, and hiking are minutes away.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch failed because the OSM URL field contains two URLs concatenated with a semicolon ('https://klahaniecampground.com;http://klahaniecampground.com'), which caused a DNS resolution error. All amenity fields default to null since OSM amenity tags cannot be treated as authoritative without website confirmation per the rules. OSM structural tags (capacity=94, fee=yes, sanitary_dump_station=yes, power_supply=yes, internet_access=yes;wlan) are noted in concerns but not used to assert amenity values. The campground appears real and open based on the complete OSM record (phone, email, address, capacity).
concerns: OSM website field contains two URLs concatenated with a semicolon ('https://klahaniecampground.com;http://klahaniecampground.com'), which caused the website fetch to fail. Canonical URL extracted as 'https://klahaniecampground.com' for this record; OSM data should be corrected.
OSM addr:street field also contains a semicolon-separated duplicate ('Darrell Bay Rd;Darrel Bay Road'); address standardised to primary value.

All amenities are unverifiable due to fetch failure. OSM tags suggest power_supply=yes, internet_access=wlan, and sanitary_dump_station=yes, but these cannot be confirmed against website content per enrichment rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, fee-based campground with 94 sites on the Sea-to-Sky corridor; complete OSM contact record with no indicators of closure. Website fetch failed due to malformed URL but the business clearly exists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Reservation contact email from OSM: reservation@klahaniecampground.com. Re-fetch of https://klahaniecampground.com (correct single URL) is recommended to populate amenity fields.

wow_evidence: functional base for cyclists between Vancouver and Whistler with easy highway access and device charging on-site
